summary: AstraZeneca furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign issuer's current report on Form 8-K) disclosing a clinical rather than transactional event: the Phase III SERENA-4 trial of Etcamah (camizestrant) plus palbociclib missed its primary progression-free survival endpoint in first-line advanced ER-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer, though a numerical improvement appeared. No stake, price, premium or advisor terms were stated; Etcamah remains approved for ESR1-mutant disease on SERENA-6, with CAMBRIA adjuvant data pending. No special-situation corporate action is present.
